Beloved Maine Cafe Announces It Will Close After 18 Years in Rockland

Allyssa MarsonPublished: October 7, 2026
  • Share on Facebook
  • Share on Twitter

Beloved Rockland Cafe Is Closing After 18 Years

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:39
Instaread

Another longtime Maine restaurant is getting ready to say goodbye, and if you’ve spent any time around Rockland, there’s a good chance you know this one.

Home Kitchen Cafe & Bakery announced that after 18 years, owners James and Susan have made the difficult decision to close the restaurant and head into retirement.

Why Home Kitchen Cafe Is Closing

In their announcement, the owners explained that Home Kitchen has always been about more than just food. From cooking from scratch to genuine hospitality, they’ve held themselves to a certain standard for nearly two decades.

But maintaining that level of quality has become increasingly difficult.

Like many in the restaurant industry, they said finding and keeping the skilled, dedicated staff needed to consistently provide the experience customers expect has become a growing struggle.

Instead of compromising what Home Kitchen Cafe stands for, they decided it was the right time to step away.

One Last Chance to Visit

The owners thanked their past and present employees, loyal customers and the Rockland community for being part of their story over the last 18 years.

Thankfully, you still have a little time to make one last visit.

Home Kitchen Cafe & Bakery will remain open through October 18, giving Mainers a final chance to stop by before this longtime Rockland favorite closes its doors.

Featured Local Savings

8 Maine Restaurants That Closed in September 2026

Gallery Credit: Sean McKenna

Bar Publica via Facebook

Bar Publica

According to an Instagram post, Bar Publica in Portland, Maine, closed on September 5, 2026.

The restaurant opened in June 2024.

Bar Publica via Facebook

Bar Publica

In the social media post, the decision to close Bar Publica was made because Chef Ron's health had become a serious concern. It noted that closing would allow him to focus on his health and safety.

The space isn't staying empty for long, as the owners plan to relaunch it as a new bar called Lucky Sevens.

Tomaso's Pizza and Burger Bar

Tomaso's Pizza and Burger Bar

According to Portland Food Map, Tomaso's Pizza and Burger Bar in Portland, Maine, closed on September 7, 2026.

The restaurant opened in March 2025.

Tomaso's Pizza and Burger Bar

Tomaso's Pizza and Burger Bar

While a specific reason wasn't given for closing, its sister spot, Tomaso's Canteen at 18 Hampshire Street in Portland, Maine, remains open.

bandaloop_restaurant via Instagram

Bandaloop

According to an Instagram post, Bandaloop in Arundel, Maine, closed on September 13, 2026.

The restaurant first opened in Kennebunkport in 2004, then moved to its current Arundel location in 2019.

bandaloop_restaurant via Instagram

Bandaloop

A July Instagram post confirmed the rumors that Bandaloop was closing and a new spot would be taking its place.

The post also noted how grateful it was for its 22 years in business.

Odd Alewives via Facebook

Odd Alewives

According to a Facebook post, Odd Alewives in Waldoboro, Maine, closed on September 20, 2026.

The brewery, restaurant and beer garden first opened in May 2017.

Odd Alewives via Facebook

Odd Alewives

In a Facebook post, Odd Alewives' owners said several employees were preparing to return to teaching and student life, leaving the business without enough staff to realistically meet demand.

They also said that after nearly a decade of projects and growth, the business had grown beyond their personal goals and ambitions, and they were ready to "move on to another chapter."

Google Maps

Portland Pie Company

According to a Facebook post, Portland Pie Company in Westbrook, Maine, closed on September 25, 2026.

The restaurant opened in 2006.

Portland Pie Company - Westbrook via Facebook

Portland Pie Company

The Portland Pie owner and CEO said in a Facebook post that its lease for the Westbrook location was coming to an end, another restaurant had approached them about taking over the space, and they accepted.

There are eight other Portland Pie Company locations in Maine.

Google Maps

Full Circle Cafe

According to a Facebook post, Full Circle Cafe in Lebanon, Maine, closed on September 26, 2026.

The restaurant opened in May 2026 in the former Hen House Cafe (pictured above).

Full Circle Cafe via Facebook

Full Circle Cafe

Full Circle Cafe, which had only been open for a few months, thanked everyone who supported it during that time in its closing announcement Facebook post.

Google Maps

Nutty Netties Cafe

According to a Facebook post, Nutty Netties at 34 Court Street, Auburn, Maine, closed on September 27, 2026.

It opened in June 2025.

Nutty Netties Cafe's via Facebook

Nutty Netties Cafe

In a social media post, the family said personal and health challenges over the past several months led them to make the difficult decision to close the Court Street location and prioritize time with their family.

Nutty Netties at 730 Center Street will remain open.

Google Maps

Taste of India

According to a Facebook post, Taste of India in Bangor, Maine, closed on September 27, 2026.

The restaurant opened in 1990.

Taste of India Inc. via Facebook

Taste of India

The Taste of India owners said in their social media post it was a difficult decision to close, but they look forward to retirement and spending more time with their family.

After nearly four decades in business, the family thanked its customers and the Bangor community for their support over the years.

30 Bucket List Restaurants in Southern Maine

Here are 30 eateries in Southern, Maine that folks told us are bucket list worthy.

Gallery Credit: Chris Sedenka

Becky's Diner via Facebook

Becky's Diner - Portland

Nothing is finah than hitting up Becky's for a tasty meal right on the working waterfront. This is a true Portland icon.

The Boathouse Waterfront Hotel & Restaurant via Facebook

The Boathouse Waterfront Hotel & Restaurant - Kennebunkport

This award-winning restaurant blends fresh local ingredients with creative flavors and expertly crafted dishes. Located right in the heart of the square, it's also the perfect place to soak in the town's charming atmosphere while enjoying an unforgettable meal.

Casa Novello via Facebook

Casa Novello - Westbrook

Delicious classics and creative dishes can be found at this neighborhood Italian joint. It's one of the true staples of Westbrook.

Chaval via Facebook

Chaval - Portland

Chaval is a European-inspired restaurant in Portland's West End. Chef Damian Sansosonetti was a finalist for a James Beard award in 2022. His wife and business partner Ilma Lopez has been a semifinalist twice for her pastry work.

Chez Rosa via Facebook

Chez Rosa - Kennebunk

A charming French bistro known for putting its own delicious spin on classic French cuisine. And yes, that includes an incredible fondue—because who doesn't love fondue? 

sdcsdc

Coletti's Pizza Factory - Biddeford

Some say its the best pizza in Maine. And those people might be right. It is to die for.

Dimillo's on the Water via Facebook

Dimillo's on the Water - Portland

The iconic Portland seafood restaurant is a Maine bucket list must. How can you leave the state without a delicious meal on the converted old boat?


Earth at Hidden Pond via Facebook

Earth at Hidden Pond - Kennebunkport

Featured on television shows and national magazines, this Kennebunkport compound is one of the prettiest restaurants in the country. This will be a meal and experience you will never forget.

Fish & Whistle via Facebook

Fish & Whistle - Biddeford

Fresh, locally caught seafood awaits the visitors of this popular establishment. Who doesn't love some good ole fish 'n chips?

Google Maps

Flo's Hot Dogs - Cape Neddick

Flo's has been pumping out delicious hot dogs since 1959. It's a
"can't miss" for tourists and locals alike. It's true Maine.

Go See Tyce via Facebook

Go See Tyce - Saco

Looking for a different style of BBQ? This little Jamaican joint down the road from Funtown USA is an absolute gem. Great food and service await those who stop by.

Great Wave Sushi via Facebook

Great Wave Sushi - Food Truck

The popular food truck is a major go-to at area festivals and breweries. You likely won't find fresher catch than here.

Honeycomb Cafe via Facebook

Honeycomb Café - Scarborough

This under-the-radar café is loaded with flavor. Homemade baked goods and fresh takes on breakfast and lunch classics truly make this charming café shine.

Jonathan's Ogunquit via Facebook

Jonathan's Ogunquit - Ogunquite

The Southern Maine staple has been a hit for nearly 50 years. The restaurant's seafood pasta dish is iconic.

Isa Bistro via Facebook

Isa Bistro - Portland

One of the highest-rated restaurants in Portland is this unpretentious gem. The menu is a hit list of delicious meals, perhaps only surpassed by the impeccable service.

Ken's Place via Facebook

Ken's Place - Scarborough

Southern Maine has its fair share of seafood joints. However, none get as much love as Ken's Place does. The voters came in strong for the tasty seasonal spot.


Krista's Restaurant via Facebook

Krista's Restaurant - Cornish

As always, a massive number of voters brought it up. And for good reason, it's simply an outstanding restaurant.

The Lost Fire via Facebook

The Lost Fire - Kennebunkport

Argentina steakhouse with delectable food, amazing drinks, and the perfect vibe. It's one of the most underrated spots in Maine. It's a meat-lovers buck list must.


Maine Diner via Facebook

Maine Diner - Wells

The diner has such a following that it has even been featured on television shows. Plus, you can get lobster for breakfast.


sdcsdc

Mangus on Water - BIddeford

Mangus on Water describes itself as an "intimate cocktail bar and restaurant." Chef Ben Jackson was one of five Mainers named as a semifinalist for the James Beard "Best Chef, Northeast" award in 2022.

Ocean Restaurant via Facebook

Ocean Restaurant - Kennebunkport

Located at the renowned Cape Arundel Inn, Ocean Restaurant takes an elevated approach to coastal cuisine. Between the beautifully crafted menu and the stunning ocean views from the dining room, it's an experience that's sure to leave a lasting impression.

Palace Diner via Facebook

Palace Diner - Biddeford

Enjoy creative diner classics in a tiny, old-school dining car. You can feel the nostalgia while eating some absolutely outstanding food at the Palace Diner.

Pine Point Grill via Facebook

Pine Point Grill - Scarborough

This popular haunt is known for its tasty Italian cuisine and upscale pub fare. It's the perfect spot for a date night or to unwind after a long day at the beach.

Red's Dairy Freeze via Facebook

Red's Dairy Freeze - South Portland

This legendary "mostly seasonal" dairy bar offers delicious treats and ice cream. It's also a state holiday when Red's opens during the cold season.

Sacred Profane via Facebook

Sacred Profane - Biddeford & Portland

This popular brewery specializes in Czech pilsner beer. It also pairs up the beer well with tremendous Czech and Central European fare.

Scarborough Fish & Lobster via Google Maps

Scarborough Fish & Lobster - Scarborough

Many will tell you this is the best joint, not just in Scarborough, but in all of Maine, to satisfy your lobster craving. You won't find anything fresher.

Sopo Seafood via Facebook

Sopo Seafood - South Portland

This market brings in freshly caught local seafood daily. It even boasts a raw bar. It's a true double threat that has been extremely popular since it opened. I've been told it's the best Lobster Dip in the state.


The Steakhouse via Facebook

The Steakhouse - Wells

One of the top vote-getters was this popular seasonal southern Maine steakhouse. If you can cook a good steak, Mainers will love you forever.

Tres Leches Cake's Flor via Facebook

Tres Leches Cake's Flor - South Portland

This outstanding joint has delicious Mexican favorites, authentic sandwiches, and plenty of tasty cakes. I mean, what else do you need?

Yosaku via Facebook

Yosaku - Portland

The Japanese restaurant has a monster sushi menu, homemade noodles, innovative dishes, and a sake program. Not a bad combination at all.


Source: Beloved Maine Cafe Announces It Will Close After 18 Years in Rockland
